display_long_description:
GreenCity 360 VR is a fully immersive virtual reality experience that takes you on a guided tour through a modern, sustainable smart home designed with eco-friendly architecture in mind. Built for Meta Quest 2 and 3, this 360 VR app features interactive hotspots for seamless room navigation and educational voiceovers explaining green technologies, energy-saving features, and smart design elements.

Perfect for real estate professionals, environmental educators, architects, and anyone interested in sustainable living, GreenCity 360 VR offers an engaging way to explore the future of home design. The high-quality 3D environments and informative pop-ups make it a powerful tool for both learning and showcasing eco conscious concepts.

Whether you’re exploring for personal interest or using it as part of a presentation, this VR tour bridges the gap between design and sustainability in an engaging and accessible way.
